caption: the galaxy engine's second act - yoshi, cloud mario and the highest-rated platformer of its decade.
about: Super mario galaxy 2 (2010) takes the first game's gravity engine and goes further: cloud, rock and spring suits, yoshi with his own fruit-driven power set, and level design so tight the game is routinely cited as the best 3d platformer ever rated. The starship freighter hub replaces the observatory, and the green-star hunt gives perfectionists their mountain.
No windows build exists, so the platform is wii - played through dolphin, rom sourced from romsfun.
